problem: The dashed linear-fit line is traced as an extra scatter series so the reconstruction has more series than the real ALD/PECVD marker data
suggested_fix: Detect and exclude dashed fit/trend lines from marker extraction so only the square/circle data markers are returned

problem: The dashed peak-pole-offset series plotted against the right secondary axis is missing; only the two primary-axis series are recovered
suggested_fix: Detect the secondary right y-axis and extract the dashed series calibrated to it

problem: Four overlapping peaks (Hafnia, Alumina, Silicon Nitride, Silica) but legend lists only three names while four colors are plotted, so Silicon Nitride is mislabeled
suggested_fix: Match the four extracted series to all four inline color-coded labels so the legend names every series

problem: Original is essentially one flat lh,1s band near y=4 but the reconstruction invents extra colored series and a blue cluster of outliers at y~3.4-3.7
suggested_fix: Suppress spurious series splitting and reject the off-band blue outliers; keep a single series matching the one legend label

problem: Two spurious purple 'o' series come from y-axis label text and the green tau=3.0 sawtooth peak is recovered at ~0.33 instead of ~0.5
suggested_fix: Exclude axis-label text glyphs from marker detection and fix y calibration so peak heights match

problem: Series-to-name assignment is shuffled (e.g. green labeled UniMech reactions, orange UniMech intermediates) so legend colors do not match the original four series
suggested_fix: Bind each extracted series to the legend entry by matching marker color/style rather than by order

problem: Six legend series (A12..A34) collapse to three recovered series; the cluster of near-overlapping curves around y=0.08 is under-separated
suggested_fix: Separate overlapping near-coincident curves by color so all six legend series are recovered

problem: One of six frequency series is missing and the gray vertical shading band creates a stray purple cluster that jumps up near 6.5 GPa
suggested_fix: Recover all six color series and ignore the gray highlight band so it does not spawn phantom points

problem: This is an annotated schematic with ellipse highlights and scattered labeled markers; only star markers are captured and y-values look miscalibrated for a non-standard figure
suggested_fix: Either skip conceptual schematic figures or calibrate from the visible numeric ticks before extracting the labeled point markers

problem: The two smooth monotonic decay curves (thr. em., thr. abs.) are reconstructed as non-monotonic scattered clouds that no longer follow the curve shape

problem: The four legend entries (poly/single crystal of two compounds) collapse to three colored series so series identity is not preserved despite points being positionally close
suggested_fix: Resolve overlapping open/filled triangle markers and map them to all four legend entries by marker fill and color

problem: The single QA->PIMD step-drop curve is well traced but two spurious blue 'PIMD' points are added as a phantom second series
suggested_fix: Suppress the two-point phantom series so only the single recovered curve remains

problem: Six labeled curves (a..f) on an inverted y-axis collapse to four recovered series so the close a/b and c/d pairs are merged
